text: A Psalm. Of David. 1 I will sing of loving devotion and justice; to You, O YHWH, I will sing praises.
I will act wisely in the way of integrity. When will You come to me? I walk about in the integrity of my heart, in the midst of my house.
I do not set before my eyes an object of worthlessness; I have hated the work of those turning aside—it shall not cling to me!
A perverse heart shall depart from me; evil I will not know.
The one slandering his neighbor in secret, I will put an end [to] him; the high of eyes and proud of heart—him I will not endure.
My eyes [are] on the faithful ones of the land, to dwell with me; the one walking in the way of integrity, he shall minister to me.
There shall not dwell within my house one working deceit; the one speaking lies shall not be fixed before my eyes.
At morning I cut off all the wicked of the land, to cut off from the city of YHWH all workers of iniquity!
